goal: Verify that a user can register as a Site Host, create a new memo, and successfully navigate to the June 2026 calendar view.

findings.instruction: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
findings.title: Severe UI rendering failure with overlapping and ghosted elements
findings.description: The dashboard interface is rendered with severe visual corruption. Multiple UI layers (sidebar, calendar, input area) are overlapping, semi-transparent, and misaligned. The calendar grid appears duplicated and shifted, and the sidebar icons are partially visible and misaligned. This indicates a critical failure in the rendering engine or CSS layout, making the application unusable.
findings.evidence: The 'AFTER' screenshot shows a chaotic layout where the sidebar, calendar, and input fields are all visible but heavily distorted, overlapping, and semi-transparent. The calendar grid is duplicated and shifted vertically. The 'No data found' message is visible but the surrounding UI is broken.
reproduction_steps: Enter 'alice' as username and 'SecureP@ss123!' as password.

findings.instruction: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
findings.title: Unexpected navigation to calendar view immediately after signup
findings.description: After successful signup, the user is redirected to a calendar view (June 2026) instead of the main dashboard feed. The success criteria state the user should see the main dashboard interface first, and the memo creation step has not yet occurred. The calendar view should only appear after explicit navigation.
findings.evidence: The 'AFTER' screenshot shows the June 2026 calendar view as the primary interface, with no memo created yet. The URL changed from '/auth/signup' to '/', but the view is not the expected dashboard feed.
reproduction_steps: Observe that the app navigates directly to the calendar view instead of the main dashboard.

findings.instruction: Click the 'June 2026' button located in the calendar widget to switch the view to the full year calendar.
findings.title: Memo list is missing in the full-year calendar view
findings.description: The success criteria requires that the previously created memo remains visible in the list below the calendar view. However, after switching to the full-year calendar view, the memo list is completely absent from the screen.
findings.evidence: In the BEFORE screenshot, the memo 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' is clearly visible below the input area. In the AFTER screenshot, the full-year calendar is displayed, but the memo list and input area are no longer present.
reproduction_steps: Log in and create a new memo.
Verify the memo is visible in the feed.
Click the 'June 2026' button to switch to the full-year calendar view.
Observe that the memo list is missing from the screen.
